title: Who Gets Recommended? Investigating Gender, Race, and Country Disparities in Paper Recommendations from Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on investigating demographic biases (gender, race, and nationality) and bibliometric factors (citation counts, team size, etc.) in paper recommendations made by LLMs. While it mentions 'ethical AI' as a topic it initially explored and acknowledges 'ethical concerns' as a motivator for the research, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems.
